summary: Well-designed solution with clean Python code and sound workflow structure. Strengths: pinned action refs, minimal permissions, proper error handling, type hints, pluggable LicenseSource design. Concerns: (1) pip install fallback to --break-system-packages is unconventional; (2) run_harness.py string parsing for 'Job succeeded' is fragile (emoji/format may vary across act versions); (3) critical fixture files (package.json, requirements.txt, config.json, mock_licenses.json) and test files (tests/) referenced but not shown, making end-to-end validation impossible; (4) no input validation shown for edge cases; (5) 540s timeout per test case is lengthy. The code quality is strong, but missing dependencies and fragile test assertions limit confidence.
